An '''S-foil servo actuator''' was part of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter's]] [[S-foils/Legends|S-foil]] deployment system. The Actuator was comprised of twin powerful servos that moved the S-foils into attack position. Once in position, the servos were locked in place by [[Cold-weld arrestor/Legends|cold-weld arrestors]].<ref name="SWS" />

The [[StarViper-class attack platform/Legends|''StarViper''-class attack platform]] used S-Foil Servo Actuators to move four adjustable wings during flight and combat maneuvers.<ref name="SOTE SB">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
